title: Handrawn tree + AI Shader
author: Shot-Abies-7822
selftext:
I played around with shaders today to create a subtle wind animation, with flying leaves, for my tree. 

  
I am working on a /pixel-art skill for Claude to help my pixel art workflow, where I can upgrade/improve my hand drawn assets, e.g. with shaders, better colors, etc.

replies.author: Shot-Abies-7822
replies.body: Thank you! :) I still find hand drawn pixel art beats AI generated one

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: Do you find yourself feel like giving up halfway through and wish ai gen didn’t suck as much? Because, well, I can draw, I just wish ai can automate it.

replies.author: Shot-Abies-7822
replies.body:
Oh yes, especially AI gen tools that use diffusion models. Pixel art lives from imperfection, and diffusion models just blend too perfectly. it feels uncanny. 

I noticed that opus 5.5 gets pretty good with a lot of references at drawing programmatically, it can work with asperite through lua scripts. so there is no diffusion model in between. it helps me generate ideas a lot, or test things fast.

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: Wow, that’s cool, Maybe I or someone can let Claude draw in krita and see what it can come up with.

replies.author: Shot-Abies-7822
replies.body: yes try it! happy to help. I can also share my custom /pixel-art skill if you are interested, and see if it is any use for you, or perhaps you can even improve it for your needs.

replies.author: Shot-Abies-7822
replies.body: will share it with you tomorrow :)
